messages.text: You are a swarm coordinator. Handle requests by delegating to the appropriate agent.

tools.name: e2e_s9_swarm_run_transfer_to_math_agent
tools.description: Transfer the conversation to math_agent. You are a math agent. When asked to compute something, call do_math with the expression. For example, for "3+4" call do_math with expr="3+4". Only handle math operations — ignore non-math requests. If there is nothing to compute, just respond with a summary. Call at most ONE transfer tool per turn.

message.description: Hand-off note for math_agent: what they should do next and any context they need.

tools.name: e2e_s9_swarm_run_transfer_to_text_agent
tools.description: Transfer the conversation to text_agent. You are a text agent. When asked to reverse text, call do_text with the text. For example, for "hello" call do_text with text="hello". If there is nothing to reverse, just respond with a summary of what you received. Call at most ONE transfer tool per turn.

message.description: Hand-off note for text_agent: what they should do next and any context they need.
